Бәйтерек Футбол Клубы | nickname = | founded = 2012 | ground = [[Astana Arena]] | capacity = 30,000{{cite web | url = https://www.uefa.com/MultimediaFiles/Download/FirstDiv/uefaorg/Publications/01/67/03/93/1670393_DOWNLOAD.pdf | title = First Division Clubs in Europe | format = PDF | publisher = [[UEFA]] | access-date = 15 March 2014}} | chairman = | manager = Oirat Saduov | league = [[Kazakhstan First Division]] | season = [[2016 Kazakhstan First Division|2014]] | position = 10th | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _blackstripes | pattern_ra1 = | leftarm1 = 00438A | body1 = 00438A | rightarm1 = 00438A | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = 00438A | current = }} '''FC Bayterek''' ({{langx|kk|Бәйтерек Футбол Клубы|Bäiterek Futbol Kluby }}) is a [[Kazakhstan|Kazakh]] [[Football (soccer)|football]] club based at the [[Astana Arena]] in [[Astana]]. The club is a state sports project, dedicated to play Kazakh graduates of Brazilian football academy [[Olé Brasil Futebol Clube]]. In its first season in 2012 Bayterek had mix of graduates born 1994 and experienced professionals. However, in future it is planned to have purely graduates of the academy.{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130218213238/http://fc-astana.kz/index.php/2011-11-10-13-29-41/236-o-sopernike-bajterek.html%23%D1%84%D0%BA-%C2%AB%D0%B1%D0%B0%D0%B9%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BA%C2%BB#фк-«байтерек»|title=About FC Bayterek}} FC Astana, on May 10, 2012"}}
